description: Samoca于1956年推出的旁轴相机。配备C.EZUMAR Anastigmat coated, F/3.5/50mm or D.EZUMAR Anastigmat coated, F/2.8/50mm depending on version. Lens versions badged just "EZUMAR" also exist.。快门速度'Prontor type' shutter with speeds 1/10 to 1/200 sec and B.。使用35mm。

specs.镜头: C.EZUMAR Anastigmat coated, F/3.5/50mm or D.EZUMAR Anastigmat coated, F/2.8/50mm depending on version. Lens versions badged just "EZUMAR" also exist.
specs.快门: 'Prontor type' shutter with speeds 1/10 to 1/200 sec and B.
specs.光圈: 1:3,5 to 1:22 for F/3.5 lens and 1:2.8 to 1:16 for F/2.8 lens
specs.取景器: optical eye-level type viewfinder with super-imposed double image rangefinder.
specs.英文简介: The Super Samoca 35 is a rangefinder camera for 35mm film, made in Japan by Sanei Sangyō K.K.
